name: fear
description: A perception of major physical or social danger that you're not prepared to handle.

variations.name: physical fear
variations.description: Perception that a life-threatening event is happening or about to happen to you or an important other.

variations.name: social fear
variations.description: Perception that something is happening or about to happen that will significantly change your social standing.
examples: I think I'm going to get fired.

variations.name: phobia
variations.description: A strong, often irrational, fear about something that could theoretically be dangerous, but most often is not.
examples: He's afraid to travel by air.

commentaries.quote: Our lives are shaped, driven, and preserved by the threat of future pain: fear of doing something dangerous, fear of missing out, fear of looking stupid, fear of appearing weak. The list goes on, for good and for bad.
The oldest and strongest emotion of mankind is fear, and the oldest and strongest kind of fear is fear of the unknown.

I must not fear. Fear is the mind-killer. Fear is the little-death that brings total obliteration. I will face my fear. I will permit it to pass over me and through me. And when it has gone past I will turn the inner eye to see its path. Where the fear has gone there will be nothing. Only I will remain.

conditions: Perception that something is happening or about to happen that will significantly change your social standing.
